svg.title: ANSI encoder ordered-batch latency ECDF
svg.desc: Four workload panels show one empirical cumulative distribution line per fresh process and revision on a logarithmic latency axis. Lines are grouped by revision but never pooled.
svg.text: Lower and farther left is better. Log latency axis; one line per fresh process, grouped by revision but unpooled.
Batches are repeated observations within a process; the process is the replication unit. Three lines/revision/panel.
Capture: ansi-encoder-ecdf-rerun | 24 process-workload vectors | 2,400 ordered batches
